name: Evidence Citation
mechanism:
This method performs linguistic analysis for AI-generated texto detection:

1. **Text Preprocessing**: The input texto is tokenized and processed for analysis.

2. **Extracción de características**: Analyzes evidence citation patterns. Relevant linguistic features are computed from the texto.

3. **Statistical Analysis**: Features are compared against baseline distributions from human-written vs AI-generated corpora.

4. **Pattern Detection**: Anomalous patterns characteristic of AI generation are identified.

5. **Cálculo de puntuación**: A confidence score (0-100) is calculated based on detected patterns.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: estadística
Medio: texto
Entrada: Raw texto string
Minimum texto length: 100 characters
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Procesamiento: Client-side NLP analysis
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 65-85% precisión independiente. Performance increases significantly when combined with complementary texto analysis methods. Results vary with texto length, language, and content type.
source: Statistical NLP analysis methods for AI-generated texto detection. Based on computational linguistics and information theory research.
useCase: Detection of AI-generated texto through evidence citation analysis. This method examines specific linguistic patterns that differ between human-written and AI-generated texto, providing complementary evidence in a multi-method analysis pipeline.
strengths:
• Fast client-side analysis with no server required
• Effective as part of a multi-method analysis pipeline
• Works across various texto types and genres
• Based on established linguistic research
• Complements other estadística texto analysis methods
limitations:
• Best used in combination with other texto analysis methods
• Performance varies with texto length (requires sufficient texto)
• May be affected by texto language and writing style
• Accuracy depends on the AI model used for generation
• Human writing can occasionally trigger false positives

references.title: Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. NeurIPS.
Jawahar, G. et al. (2020). Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey. COLING.
